jp: …(あなたの言葉を聞いていない)

en: ( ignores you...)
en_grezzo: "(" + he(tc) + " ignores you...)"
contesto: chatMore lang("…(あなたの言葉を聞いていない)", "(" + he(tc) + " ignores you...)"), strbye
it: "(...non ti sta ascoltando)"

jp: (現在の立ち姿はfaceだ)
jp_grezzo: "(現在の立ち姿はface" + cdata(CDATA_FACE, tc) + "だ)"
en: (Currently using face)
en_grezzo: "(Currently using face" + cdata(CDATA_FACE, tc) + ")"
contesto: buff = lang("(現在の立ち姿はface" + cdata(CDATA_FACE, tc) + "だ)", "(Currently using face" + cdata(CDATA_FACE, tc) + ")")
it: "(Posa attuale: face" + cdata(CDATA_FACE, tc) + ")"

jp: (現在、立ち姿は決まっていない)
jp_grezzo: "(現在、立ち姿は決まっていない)"
en: (Current: No Tachi-e)
en_grezzo: "(Current: No Tachi-e)"
it: Al momento non hai scelto nessuna posa.

jp: 次へ>>>
it: Successiva >>>

jp: <<<前へ
it: <<< Precedente

jp: 戻る
jp_grezzo: "戻る"
en: Cancel
en_grezzo: "Cancel"
it: Annulla

jp: エーテル抗体を1本渡す
jp_grezzo: "エーテル抗体を1本渡す"
en: (Hand her a potion of cure corruption.)
en_grezzo: "(Hand her a potion of cure corruption.)"
it: (Darle una pozione di cura della corruzione)

jp: うそつき！
jp_grezzo: "うそつき！"
en: Liar!
en_grezzo: "Liar!"
it: Bugie!

jp: エーテル抗体を1本渡した。
jp_grezzo: "エーテル抗体を1本渡した。"
en: You give her a potion.
en_grezzo: "You give her a potion."
it: Le dai una pozione di cura della corruzione.

jp: え…あ、ありがと～！！おかあさん…薬だよ。これでよくなるよね？
jp_grezzo: "え…あ、ありがと～！！おかあさん…薬だよ。これでよくなるよね？"
en: R-Really? Mommy, mommy!  gave us a cure! Are you gonna be okay now?
en_grezzo: "R-Really? Mommy, mommy! " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + " gave us a cure! Are you gonna be okay now?"
contesto: chatMore lang("え…あ、ありがと～！！おかあさん…薬だよ。これでよくなるよね？", "R-Really? Mommy, mommy! " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + " gave us a cure! Are you gonna be okay now?")
it: "D-davvero? Mamma, mamma! " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + " ci ha portato la medicina! Adesso guarisci, vero?"

jp: 累計放出量から予測した状態を、ソピアーから聞いていたが…それよりもだいぶ弱っているようだ。
jp_grezzo: "累計放出量から予測した状態を、ソピアーから聞いていたが…それよりもだいぶ弱っているようだ。"
en: Sophia told me about the condition of this thing that she predicted based on reading its cumulative emissions... but it seems to be much weaker than that.
en_grezzo: "Sophia told me about the condition of this thing that she predicted based on reading its cumulative emissions... but it seems to be much weaker than that."
it: Sophia mi aveva detto in che stato doveva essere, contando quanto ha emesso finora... ma sembra molto più debole di così.

jp: 一度でいいから会いたいよ…。どうすれば会えるの？こいつらの知識を取り込めばわかるの？
jp_grezzo: "一度でいいから会いたいよ…。どうすれば会えるの？こいつらの知識を取り込めばわかるの？"
en: Father... How I long to see him, even if it's only once... What is it I must do to see him? If I absorb the knowledge of these people, will I find out?
en_grezzo: "Father... How I long to see him, even if it's only once... What is it I must do to see him? If I absorb the knowledge of these people, will I find out?"
it: Padre... Vorrei vederlo, anche una volta sola... Che cosa devo fare per vederlo? Se prendo dentro di me il sapere di questa gente, lo capirò?

jp: 情けをかけるのは危険だ。仕留めるぞ。
jp_grezzo: "情けをかけるのは危険だ。仕留めるぞ。"
en: Don't make the mistake of showing mercy. Let's finish this.
en_grezzo: "Don't make the mistake of showing mercy. Let's finish this."
it: Avere pietà adesso è pericoloso. Finiamola qui.

jp: やっと会えた…！父上っ！
jp_grezzo: "やっと会えた…！父上っ！"
en: Finally we meet, father!
en_grezzo: "Finally we meet, father!"
it: Finalmente vi ho trovato...! Padre!

jp: ふふっ…最期に…娘の声が聞こえる…なんて。もう、目が…かすんで…きました。
jp_grezzo: "ふふっ…最期に…娘の声が聞こえる…なんて。もう、目が…かすんで…きました。"
en: Heh... I'm dying but I can hear my daughter's voice somehow. Oh, my vision... is already... getting... blurry.
en_grezzo: "Heh... I'm dying but I can hear my daughter's voice somehow. Oh, my vision... is already... getting... blurry."
it: Eh eh... in punto di morte... sentire la voce di mia figlia... Ormai gli occhi... si stanno... annebbiando.

jp: そこの冒険者…少しどいていてください。
jp_grezzo: "そこの冒険者…少しどいていてください。"
en: You're in my way Adventurer, make way please.
en_grezzo: "You're in my way Adventurer, make way please."
it: Voi che cercate avventura, fatemi largo un momento.

jp: 新型緩和薬を投与…効くといいのですが。
jp_grezzo: "新型緩和薬を投与…効くといいのですが。"
en: The new pain killer has been administered. However, I wonder if it's effective...
en_grezzo: "The new pain killer has been administered. However, I wonder if it's effective..."
it: Somministrato il nuovo analgesico... speriamo che faccia effetto.

jp: この様子だと、薬が回り切る前に肉体が崩壊しそうですね…。今、ここで次元炉の摘出を行います。耐えてください、父上！
jp_grezzo: "この様子だと、薬が回り切る前に肉体が崩壊しそうですね…。今、ここで次元炉の摘出を行います。耐えてください、父上！"
en: In this state the body will break down before the medicine manages to take effect... For now let's remove the dimensional reactor. Please endure, father!
en_grezzo: "In this state the body will break down before the medicine manages to take effect... For now let's remove the dimensional reactor. Please endure, father!"
it: Di questo passo il corpo cede prima che il farmaco giri tutto... Estraggo subito il reattore dimensionale, qui e ora. Resistete, Padre!

jp: 私は…助かったのですか？
jp_grezzo: "私は…助かったのですか？"
en: I-I'm saved?
en_grezzo: "I-I'm saved?"
it: Io... sono salvo?

jp: 父上…！よかった、本当によかった…。
jp_grezzo: "父上…！よかった、本当によかった…。"
en: Oh, I'm so glad, father!
en_grezzo: "Oh, I'm so glad, father!"
it: Padre...! Che sollievo, che sollievo davvero...

jp: ランカータ、なぜ貴方がここに？衛生兵なのに一人でここまで来たのですか？
jp_grezzo: "ランカータ、なぜ貴方がここに？衛生兵なのに一人でここまで来たのですか？"
en: Why are you here Lankata? The medic came here on their own?
en_grezzo: "Why are you here Lankata? The medic came here on their own?"
it: Lankata, perché siete qui? Siete un'infermiera da campo: siete venuta fin quassù da sola?

jp: その話は後です。さぁ、脱出しましょう。
jp_grezzo: "その話は後です。さぁ、脱出しましょう。"
en: We'll talk about that later. Let's escape first.
en_grezzo: "We'll talk about that later. Let's escape first."
it: Ne parliamo dopo. Su, andiamo via di qui.

jp: おっといけません。その前に。
jp_grezzo: "おっといけません。その前に。"
en: Uh-oh, we can't go that way.
en_grezzo: "Uh-oh, we can't go that way."
it: Ah, no. Di lì non si passa. Un momento.

jp: 名も知らぬ冒険者…貴方が露払いをしていなければ、私はきっと間に合わなかったでしょう。貴方は降りかかる火の粉を払っただけでしょうが、結果的に助かりました。感謝します。
jp_grezzo: "名も知らぬ冒険者…貴方が露払いをしていなければ、私はきっと間に合わなかったでしょう。貴方は降りかかる火の粉を払っただけでしょうが、結果的に助かりました。感謝します。"
en: Unknown adventurer... if it hadn't been for you, I probably wouldn't have made it. You may be thinking that you've just brushed off a few embers, but in the end, you've saved the day. I thank you.
en_grezzo: "Unknown adventurer... if it hadn't been for you, I probably wouldn't have made it. You may be thinking that you've just brushed off a few embers, but in the end, you've saved the day. I thank you."
it: Voi di cui non so il nome... se non aveste ripulito la strada, non sarei arrivata in tempo. Per voi sarà stato solo scacciare qualche favilla, ma alla fine mi avete salvata. Vi ringrazio.

jp: は次元の扉を開けた。
jp_grezzo: name(tc) + "は次元の扉を開けた。"
en: opens a dimensional door.
en_grezzo: name(tc) + " opens a dimensional door."
contesto: txt lang(name(tc) + "は次元の扉を開けた。", name(tc) + " opens a dimensional door.")
it: name(tc) + " apre una porta dimensionale."

jp: 飽きた。
jp_grezzo: "飽きた。"
en: I tire of this.
en_grezzo: "I tire of this."
it: Che noia.

jp: 部屋の空気が突然緊張し、高熱を放つ火球が現れた。
jp_grezzo: "部屋の空気が突然緊張し、高熱を放つ火球が現れた。"
en: The air in the room suddenly became tense, and a fireball of blazing heat appeared.
en_grezzo: "The air in the room suddenly became tense, and a fireball of blazing heat appeared."
it: L'aria della stanza si fa di colpo tesa, e compare una sfera di fuoco incandescente.

jp: ッ…！？これはまずい！！
jp_grezzo: "ッ…！？これはまずい！" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！"
en: What the...!? Look out! !
en_grezzo: "What the...!? Look out! " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "!"
contesto: chatMore lang("ッ…！？これはまずい！" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！", "What the...!? Look out! " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "!"), strmore, findchara(CREATURE_ID_YAYAUHQUI_TEZCATLIPOCA)
it: "Ma...!? Attenzione! " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "!"

jp: 遊びは終わりだ…灰になるがいい。
jp_grezzo: "遊びは終わりだ…灰になるがいい。"
en: I am finished with your games... All of you shall turn to ash.
en_grezzo: "I am finished with your games... All of you shall turn to ash."
it: Il gioco è finito... diventerete cenere.

jp: 辺りをおぞましい火焔が包み込んでいく。
jp_grezzo: "辺りをおぞましい火焔が包み込んでいく。"
en: A horrific wave of fire envelops the area!
en_grezzo: "A horrific wave of fire envelops the area!"
it: Un'ondata di fuoco spaventosa avvolge ogni cosa!

jp: あなたは懸命に脚の震えを抑えようとしたが、難しかった。
jp_grezzo: "あなたは懸命に脚の震えを抑えようとしたが、難しかった。"
en: You try your hardest to suppress the shaking in your legs, but it proves difficult...
en_grezzo: "You try your hardest to suppress the shaking in your legs, but it proves difficult..."
it: Cerchi con tutte le forze di frenare il tremito delle gambe, ma è dura...

jp: はあなたを庇って灰になった。
jp_grezzo: cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cnt) + "はあなたを庇って灰になった。"
en: shielded you and turned to ashes.
en_grezzo: name(cnt) + " shielded you and turned to ashes."
contesto: txt lang(cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cnt) + "はあなたを庇って灰になった。", name(cnt) + " shielded you and turned to ashes.")
it: name(cnt) + " ti fa scudo e diventa cenere."

jp: …どれくらい時間がたっただろう。あなたは半分灰になった身体で、よろよろと起き上がった…。
jp_grezzo: "…どれくらい時間がたっただろう。あなたは半分灰になった身体で、よろよろと起き上がった…。"
en: ...After what felt like an eternity, you stagger to your feet, with half of your body turned into ash...
en_grezzo: "...After what felt like an eternity, you stagger to your feet, with half of your body turned into ash..."
it: ...Chissà quanto tempo è passato. Ti rialzi barcollando, col corpo per metà ridotto in cenere...

jp: 声が聞こえる…。
jp_grezzo: "声が聞こえる…。"
en: You can hear someone's voice...
en_grezzo: "You can hear someone's voice..."
it: Si sente una voce...
